title: Cookie Policy
meta_description: Categories of cookies (essential, analytics, marketing), consent management and control instructions.

blocks.x: What cookies and similar technologies run on achalasolutions.com, what each category does, and how you control them, written to be read, not to be endured.

These make the site work: session integrity, security tokens, and your cookie-consent choice itself. They do not require consent and cannot be switched off in our hosting configuration without breaking core functionality. Their lifetime matches the technical purpose, from the browsing session up to 12 months for the consent record.
Where the site remembers a choice you made (for example collapsing a menu or a saved view), it is stored locally in your browser and is not used to identify you elsewhere.

We measure aggregate page performance, page views, referrers, rough geography, load times, to find broken journeys and slow pages. Analytics runs only after you accept non-essential cookies, IP addresses are truncated where the tool supports it, and we do not build advertising profiles from this data.

We currently run no third-party advertising cookies. If that ever changes, this section, the consent banner and the cookie table below will be updated together, and acceptance will be requested before any marketing tag fires.

You can withdraw or change consent at any time via the cookie controls on this site, or delete and block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may break site functionality such as search and form submission. Your consent choice is stored under the categories listed below.
